content:
Inspired by @joshua’s post on his defaults, here are some of mine.

📨 Mail Client - Mimestream mostly, but also Mail.app and the Fastmail app

📮 Mail Server - Google and Fastmail

📝 Notes - Drafts + Obsidian and Notes.app for family shared notes

✅ To-Do - Things for personal and work, Reminders for family

📷 iPhone Photo Shooting - Camera.app and Halide

🟦 Photo Management - Photos.app and Google Photos for redundancy. I find that Google is a lot better at search.

📆 Calendar - Calendar.app and Google Calendar

📁 Cloud File Storage - Google Drive and iCloud

📖 RSS - Feedbin + Reeder

🙍🏻‍♂️ Contacts - Contacts.app with Google and Fastmail

🌐 Browser - Arc, Safari and Quiche Browser

💬 Chat - Beeper, which provides a secure single interface for the many chat apps I use.

🔖 Bookmarks - Raindrop.io

📑 Read It Later - Readwise Reader

📜 Word Processing - Google Docs

📈 Spreadsheets - Google Sheets

📊 Presentations - Google Slides, Pitch and Canva

🛒 Shopping Lists - Notes.app

💰 Budgeting and Personal Finance - Tiller

📰 News - Plain text, web-based sources like 68k.news, NPR and CNN

🎵 Music - Mostly Spotify, Bandcamp, but trying to shift to Apple Music

🎤 Podcasts - Overcast, but I’m thinking of switching back to Pocketcasts
